displayName: Turbofan copilot: a question cost far more than normal

documentation.content: The 99th percentile of estimated cost per question passed 0.01 USD, about fifty times the measured 0.0002 USD. Likely causes: the prompt grew (more or larger evidence passages), the model was changed to a more expensive one, or a question produced an unusually long answer. Check the prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, and model fields of the query events. A percentile is used because Cloud Monitoring cannot compare a distribution metric to a threshold without an aligner that returns a single number.

conditions.displayName: 99th percentile cost per question above 0.01 USD
